blocks.en: It is easy to see that the space $\widetilde L^p(\Omega)$ is not complete (see Problem~\ref{ex:continuous-lp-not-complete}). We therefore make the following definition.
blocks.zh: 容易看出空间 $\widetilde L^p(\Omega)$ 不完备 (见 Problem~\ref{ex:continuous-lp-not-complete}). 因此作如下定义.

blocks.en: Let $1\leq p<\infty$. Then $L^p(\Omega)$ is the completion of $\widetilde L^p(\Omega)$.
blocks.zh: 设 $1\leq p<\infty$. 那么 $L^p(\Omega)$ 是 $\widetilde L^p(\Omega)$ 的完备化.
blocks.label: def:lp-space-completion

blocks.en: If a sequence $f_n$ is Cauchy in $\widetilde L^p(\Omega)$, then it follows from Hölder\textquotesingle s inequality that $\int_\Omega f_n\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}$ converges for every test function $\phi$. Hence $f_n$ converges in the sense of distributions, and by Theorem~\ref{thm:distribution-sequential-completeness} every element of $L^p(\Omega)$ defines a distribution.
blocks.zh: 若序列 $f_n$ 在 $\widetilde L^p(\Omega)$ 中为 Cauchy 序列, 则由 Hölder 不等式, 对每个试验函数 $\phi$, $\int_\Omega f_n\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}$ 都收敛. 因而 $f_n$ 在分布意义下收敛, 并且由 Theorem~\ref{thm:distribution-sequential-completeness}, $L^p(\Omega)$ 的每个元素都定义了一个分布.
blocks.label: rem:lp-completion-defines-distributions

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We need to show that different elements of $L^p(\Omega)$ correspond to different distributions.
blocks.zh: 需要证明 $L^p(\Omega)$ 的不同元素对应不同的分布.

blocks.en: Let $f_n$ be a Cauchy sequence in $\widetilde L^p(\Omega)$ $(1\leq p<\infty)$ and assume that $\int_\Omega f_n\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\to0$ for every $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$. Then $\|f_n\|_p\to0$.
blocks.zh: 设 $f_n$ 为 $\widetilde L^p(\Omega)$ 中的 Cauchy 序列 $(1\leq p<\infty)$, 并假设对每个 $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ 有 $\int_\Omega f_n\phi\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\to0$. 那么 $\|f_n\|_p\to0$.
blocks.label: lem:lp-completion-faithful-distribution-inclusion

blocks.en: Consider the sequence $f_n(x)=\exp(-nx^2)$. It is easy to see that $f_n\to0$ in $\widetilde L^p(\mathbb{R})$ for $1\leq p<\infty$, and thus the sequence can be identified with the constant function $0\in L^p(\mathbb{R})$. However, note that $f_n(0)=1$ for every $n$. This example should convince the reader that we cannot regard elements of $L^p$ as functions with point values. Fortunately, using the results of measure theory, it can be shown that one can ``almost'' do so. In measure theory, elements of $L^p$ are defined as equivalence classes of functions which differ only on ``sets of measure zero'' (for instance, at a finite number of points). More precisely, $L^p(\Omega)$ is the set of all (equivalence classes of) Lebesgue measurable functions $f$ such that $|f|^p$ is integrable. This definition is equivalent to ours. To show this equivalence, it suffices to prove that continuous bounded functions are dense in the space $L^p$ (as defined in integration theory). Since we do not assume familiarity with Lebesgue integration, we shall not pursue this point further.
blocks.zh: 考虑序列 $f_n(x)=\exp(-nx^2)$. 容易看出, 当 $1\leq p<\infty$ 时, $f_n\to0$ 在 $\widetilde L^p(\mathbb{R})$ 中成立, 因而该序列可与常值函数 $0\in L^p(\mathbb{R})$ 相认同. 但注意, 对每个 $n$ 都有 $f_n(0)=1$. 这个例子应使读者相信, 不能把 $L^p$ 的元素视为具有点值的函数. 幸运的是, 利用测度论的结果可以证明, ``几乎'' 可以这样做. 在测度论中, $L^p$ 的元素定义为仅在 ``零测集'' 上不同的函数的等价类 (例如, 只在有限个点上不同). 更精确地, $L^p(\Omega)$ 是所有使 $|f|^p$ 可积的 Lebesgue 可测函数 $f$ (的等价类) 的集合. 这一定义与我们的定义等价. 为证明这一等价性, 只需证明有界连续函数在空间 $L^p$ (按积分理论中的定义) 中稠密. 由于未假定读者熟悉 Lebesgue 积分, 这里不再深入讨论这一点.
blocks.label: rem:lp-point-values-and-measure-zero

blocks.en: Let $X_1$ and $X_2$ be Banach spaces. Then $X_1\times X_2$ is a Banach space with the norm $\|(x_1,x_2)\|=\|x_1\|+\|x_2\|$. In this situation, we shall sometimes identify $X_1$ with $X_1\times\{0\}$ and $X_2$ with $\{0\}\times X_2$. We then write $x_1+x_2$ for $(x_1,x_2)$.
blocks.zh: 设 $X_1$ 和 $X_2$ 为 Banach 空间. 那么 $X_1\times X_2$ 在范数 $\|(x_1,x_2)\|=\|x_1\|+\|x_2\|$ 下为 Banach 空间. 在这一情形中, 有时将 $X_1$ 与 $X_1\times\{0\}$, $X_2$ 与 $\{0\}\times X_2$ 相认同. 此时用 $x_1+x_2$ 表示 $(x_1,x_2)$.
blocks.label: ex:banach-direct-product
